data.gender_notes: Saheel is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Saheel is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sahyah', which means friend, companion, or helper. This name is often given to a child who is expected to be a source of support and comfort to others. The name Saheel carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Saheel usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saheel is a name that symbolizes the divine presence of a trusted friend or companion in one's life. It reminds us of the importance of having strong relationships and connections with others, and the role that these relationships play in our spiritual growth and development.
data.etymology: Saheel belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saheel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
